title: Amazing photographer that helped my brand image
text: Rachele was very professional and helpful. She did product photography and model shoots for me for 3 launches. She recommended me locations, types of shots, lightning, type of clothes and anything I needed so make the shoot and the result incredible. Its a stressful experience trying to start a small business and the image is everything. She helped me find mine! I would definitely recommend to anyone looking for professional and to your needs photographer. Thank you Rachele! See you soon for our next session!
